scope: Implementation validation before public packaging; desktop changes and browser experimental defaults. Source push and release verification are recorded separately.
limitations: CPU 100% means one logical core, summed owned processes. Whole-GPU metrics include other applications; app-only GPU/VRAM not reliably measured.
mpv A/V timing is available for head-pose clips; real driver clip has no audio. Input-to-display and speaker-to-screen latency unmeasured.
1080p30 after sample had 1 display drop in 10 s, 0 decoder drops; later real segments including physical 4K display had 0 observed drops. These short samples are not a long soak.
Actual attached 1080p + 4K (150%) tested. Internal frame remains capped at 2560x1440. Physical unplug and fresh single-monitor startup untested.
Real 1080p60 high-motion, severe darkness/noise, HDR and subjective aesthetic quality unverified. Synthetic 60fps codec clip contains repeated frames.
No semantic occlusion classifier. Color/flow reliability are conservative heuristics. Similar-color obstructions and difficult side faces can still fail.
Cut detection is heuristic. Browser swap/interpolation remain experimental, defaults off; no new conservative-mode switch and no VSR activation claim.
Bounded media identity can alias same-sized edits outside sampled regions; identical content copies share settings.

During focused OS keyboard tests, unrelated auto-repeating Right key events advanced playback. Scoped R press/release without changing foreground kept PTS exactly 35 and restored the original-preview state.
browserComparisonBaseline: local Edge 0.5.0 before the 0.6.0 default migration; not public Git tag v0.4.1
